intentProfile.routingReason: User selected Apple (Pinguo) Design Library as the primary constraint source for redesigning the Quiz Helper browser-extension prototype UI based on docs/demo.html content framework, with light/dark dual-mode support.

designSource.uiKitSummary: Apple-store-like merchandising kit: white/black surfaces, hairline borders, capsule pill buttons, generous whitespace, editorial headings.
designSource.designDecisionSummary: Redesign Quiz Helper browser extension UI (popup / content answer panel / options page / drawer / toast messages) following Apple-inspired Pinguo design system: Pinguo Blue #007aff primary, Space Black / Silver Mist neutrals, DM Sans + PingFang SC type, 1.2rem soft radius with capsule pill buttons, whisper-light shadows with 1px borders, light/dark dual-mode via semantic tokens. Content framework follows docs/demo.html sections: Popup default + model dropdown states, in-page answer panel with answering/loading/empty states and floating bubble, Options sidebar with 8 sections, right-side drawers for model edit / search provider / parse rule / bank detail, top toast messages.

continuityAnchors: capsule pill primary buttons (rounded-full, brand blue fill)
1px hairline borders over shadows for static surfaces
soft 1.2rem radius cards with whitespace-led hierarchy
